## Open links and hardware tests

Open links are the places where a reconstructed control-flow graph stops: an indirect or external call, an unknown producer, a register meaning. `complete` on a fiche covers its own instructions only, never what these links lead to. Hardware tests are listed with their own status, including results that contradicted the reading.

| Open link | Function | What is unknown | Proof needed |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ARM7M-ADDR-Q1` | `addr_adjust_by_version (working name, not Apple's)` | What the argument and the result are (an address in which address space, and whether -1 means failure), and who calls this method. The decoding is confirmed by the bytes (cmp r1,r0; it lo; mov.w r1,-1: an unsigned comparison, replacement when r1 < r0, as ARM defines LO). What is odd is the behaviour: for iop-version 1 the result is replaced by -1 when the offset is BELOW the size, which is not an ordinary range check. The condition is not to be inverted to fit a presumed name. | find the callers through the table slot at 0x807143f8 and read how they use the result |
